## `client.jobs`

List the jobs of a project, start one, pause and resume its schedule.

### `client.jobs.list`

Signature: `client.jobs.list(environment: str, *, repository: str | None = None, sort: str | None = None, order: str | None = None) -> list[Job]`

List the jobs of the deployed repositories (needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this repository's jobs. |
| `sort` | `str | None` | `None` | What the jobs are sorted by: ``name``, ``status`` (the last run's), ``last_run``, ``next_run``, ``repository`` or ``environment``; a job without a value comes last. Without it (and `order`), by repository, then name. |
| `order` | `str | None` | `None` | ``asc`` or ``desc``; by default ``desc`` for ``last_run``, ``asc`` for the others. |

Returns: `list of Job`. By repository, then name, unless sorted otherwise.

### `client.jobs.get`

Signature: `client.jobs.get(environment: str, job: str, *, repository: str | None = None) -> Job`

Show one job with its triggers (needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `job` | `str` | required | The job's name. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Repository name; needed only when several repositories declare a job of this name. |

Returns: `Job`. The job, as `list` returns it.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the job does not exist; the message lists the jobs that do. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If several repositories declare it and none was named. |

### `client.jobs.start`

Signature: `client.jobs.start(environment: str, repository: str, job: str) -> JobStart`

Start a job, or let the start wait for the active run of its project (needs `RUN`).

A paused job can be started. The run principal follows the rules of `Runs.start`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |
| `job` | `str` | required | The job's name. |

Returns: `JobStart`. The queued run (`run`), or the waiting start (`waiting`) with the run it waits for.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the job does not exist; the message lists the jobs that do. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If no run principal is bound in a protected environment. |

### `client.jobs.pause`

Signature: `client.jobs.pause(environment: str, repository: str, job: str) -> Job`

Pause a job's schedule (needs `DEPLOY` on the environment).

A waiting start is kept and still happens; a start by hand still works.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |
| `job` | `str` | required | The job's name. |

Returns: `Job`. The job.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the job has no schedule, so there is nothing to pause. |

### `client.jobs.resume`

Signature: `client.jobs.resume(environment: str, repository: str, job: str) -> Job`

Resume a job's schedule from now (needs `DEPLOY` on the environment).

The times missed while it was paused do not fire.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |
| `job` | `str` | required | The job's name. |

Returns: `Job`. The job.

### `client.jobs.notify_test`

Signature: `client.jobs.notify_test(environment: str, repository: str, job: str) -> str`

Queue a test message to a job's webhook (needs `DEPLOY` on the environment).

A worker sends it like any notification, with clearly fake run data. Read the result with `delivery`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |
| `job` | `str` | required | The job's name. |

Returns: `str`. The delivery's id.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the job does not exist; the message lists the jobs that do. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the job has no ``notify:`` in the environment. |

### `client.jobs.delivery`

Signature: `client.jobs.delivery(environment: str, delivery_id: str) -> Delivery`

Read one notification delivery (needs `DEPLOY`, `RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `delivery_id` | `str` | required | The delivery, as `notify_test` returned it. |

Returns: `Delivery`. Its state, attempts and short result.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the delivery does not exist in the environment. |
